subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` through the Plugin SDK, including the locked-harness owner reset handoff, as the supported solution for channel lifecycle boundaries?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and proven, but repository policy treats new plugin API and session ownership contracts as compatibility-sensitive product architecture that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Approve the owner-aware API
options.body: Accept the documented reset primitive and harness handoff as the canonical reusable plugin contract, then refresh and merge this PR.

options.title: Narrow the capability
options.body: Keep the guarded lifecycle reset implementation but expose it only through a narrower Teams or internal runtime seam instead of a permanent general Plugin SDK API.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Do not add lifecycle reset API surface until maintainers define a broader cross-channel session-retention and harness-reset policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the owner-aware API
recommendation.body: Accept the documented reset primitive and harness handoff as the canonical reusable plugin contract, then refresh and merge this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the personal-chat scoping commit and are the clearest available participant connected to the behavior and current review routing.
